businesses.business: title insurance and real estate information services

offering_description.value: Underwrites title insurance and provides escrow, closing and real estate data and software for residential and commercial property transactions. Sells to home buyers and sellers, mortgage lenders and real estate professionals through independent agents and company-owned offices, earning premiums and fees on each transaction.

primary_products.value: title insurance policies; escrow services; real estate data; real estate software

primary_services.value: title search and examination; closing and settlement services; property information reports

customer_segment.value: B2B: mortgage lenders, real estate agents, homebuilders, commercial property investors; B2C: home buyers and sellers purchasing owner's or lender's title policies

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial real estate; mortgage lending

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: title insurance premiums paid on property transactions; service fees: fees for title searches, escrow and closing services; transaction or usage fees: fees for real estate data and software use
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites title insurance policies, sold to buyers and lenders; service provider: performs title searches and closings, sold to lenders and buyers; software / platform: real estate data and software, sold to lenders and agents
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: all US states, plus operations in Canada, Mexico, UK, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: title insurance, escrow and closing services, and real estate data and software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to lenders and builders; agents / brokers: independent title agents issuing policies locally; own locations: company-owned title and escrow offices; online: online ordering of property data and software
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; own locations; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: title insurance underwriting and agency licensed by state insurance departments
